title: Siman 314
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: אָמַרכָּל מַה שֶּׁרוֹצִין לַעֲשׂוֹת בִּשְׁבִילִי יֵשׁ עַל זֶה כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה מְנִיעוֹת. כִּי כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה עוֹמְדִים וְאוֹרְבִים עַל- זֶה לְקַלְקֵל אוֹתוֹ הַדָּבָר
segments.en: (24.) I heard in his name that he said: "The lowest of my people — I am leading him on a path of a very great tzaddik as of today." gerim gerurim [dragged converts] who were dragged over because of a decree of persecution."> And how much more so should one who is close to him be envied — and certainly one who merits to [have Rabbainu] extend a hand to him and draw him close. lulke [pipe]. When I will be old like Rabbi Baruch, I will sit in a house [my house] of gold, of silver — certainly!">
